meta.title: Vendor fills a dropdown column "Make": leave it unselected when it is required
gaps: Explicitly verify that the selected event template has a required dropdown column named Make and that it is unselected before submission
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Explicitly verify that the selected event template has a required dropdown column named Make and that it is unselected before submission

plan.title: Required Make dropdown blocks vendor bid

steps.note: Open an existing live event suitable for vendor bidding.
Move to the vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Check that the bid sheet visibly includes the Make column named by the case.
Submit a quote for 100 without selecting a Make option and require positive evidence that Procol refuses the bid.
